The '''Hurt Vectors hideout''' was a five [[Meter/Legends|meter]] by five meter room seven stories above street level located on the lower levels of [[Vandalar City]]. It had a small garage one story below. It was used by [[Hurt Vectors]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]]. It was three blocks from a [[Vandalar City police station|police station]].
